data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 0.441 million on prior year reserves in 2017, calculated from the claims development triangle for underwriting years 2014 and 2015. The report also notes a net deficit of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves, primarily attributed to a reduction in premium on the casualty reinsurance class of business. The 2014 year of account was reported to have no material developments. The syndicate experienced material losses in 2017 from Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, with a combined net exposure of GBP 7.704 million, impacting both the 2017 and 2016 underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative explicitly states a net deficit of GBP 1.8m on prior year reserves. However, the prior year development figure of GBP 0.441m is calculated from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2014 and 2015, which is a gross figure and thus preferred. The net loss for named events (HIM) was originally stated in USD and converted to GBP using the year-end exchange rate of 1.35 USD/GBP.
